title: Finiteness transfer across an integral dense-open counit
statement: For an algebraically closed field k and constructible curve coefficient pair P=(X,A) [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion], let U be a dense open with inclusion j. Encode A and j_!j^*A [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] by the canonical integral equivalence as F and G. All groups H^q(X,F) of the underlying abelian sheaf are finite if and only if all groups H^q(X,G) are finite [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No finite coefficient ring, properness or ambient reducedness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0GJA (lemma-restrict-to-open), proof, exact-sequence finiteness argument; Tag 095L (lemma-ses-j-shriek)

proof.text: Form the integral-module open-closed short exact sequence and forget it to abelian sheaves, using shortExact_map_forget₂. Its boundary cohomology is finite in every degree. The proved integral open-extension comparison identifies its first term with the encoded G.

If F has finite cohomology, degree zero of the first term injects into H^0(F), by Ext.postcomp_mk₀_injective_of_mono. For q=n+1 use Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁' and ShortComplex.Exact.ab_finite on H^n(Q) -> H^q(J) -> H^q(F). Transfer finiteness along the explicit cohomology equivalence J=G.

Conversely apply Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₂' and ShortComplex.Exact.ab_finite to H^q(J) -> H^q(F) -> H^q(Q) in every degree. Both outer groups are finite. This avoids a separate higher-degree comparison and a pullback ladder.

lean.statement:
theorem dense_open_integral_cohomology_finiteness {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (P : CurveCoefficientPair k) (hP : P.IsConstructible)
    (U : P.C.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set P.C)) :
    let E := (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} ℤ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).inv ⋙
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{u + 1} ℤ ≃+* ℤ).toRingHom
    let F := (sheafCompose P.C.smallEtaleTopology E).obj P.F
    let B := (Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} U.ι).obj
      ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} U.ι).obj P.F)
    let G := (sheafCompose P.C.smallEtaleTopology E).obj B
    let T := sheafCompose P.C.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (∀ q : ℕ, Finite (Sheaf.H (T.obj F) q)) ↔
      (∀ q : ℕ, Finite (Sheaf.H (T.obj G) q))
